notes: Override of OggBitstreamDecoder's abstract decodePacket (see OggBitstreamDecoder.csv method2964). As the 'null'/no-op stream implementation this override does no real decoding: it only conditionally resets the companion tick-ish counter anInt9041 to -51 when magicCheck >= -91 (true at essentially any real call, since submitPacket always passes -120.toByte() as the tag - so this branch is effectively always taken) and increments the per-instance packet counter anInt9046.

Override of OggBitstreamDecoder's abstract close (see OggBitstreamDecoder.csv method2961). No-op cleanup for the null stream: increments anInt9045 and self-recurses with -50 when magicCheck != 13 - dead in practice since OggMediaStream's sole close call site passes 13.toByte(), matching the pattern already documented for this method on the base class.

Companion reset: nulls anIntArray9042 (per-region id table, also referenced from NpcSpawnDecoder.kt as region ids) and aString9043 unconditionally, and sets anInt9041 = -95 when clearTickCounter is true. Given anInt9041 doubles as the NPC-update tick counter (incremented in NpcUpdateProcessor.method856 and compared against Npc.anInt10306), this looks like a scene/session teardown reset that piggybacks on the otherwise unrelated NullOggStream class - consistent with the widespread decompiler field cross-merge pattern noted in PLAN.md.
